label: PF Backlog 387
title: Fix: gen_backlog_summary.py cannot import core when run as a script; check_docs_fresh ignores its exit code (BACKLOG-SUMMARY freshness is a silent no-op)
body: scripts/dev/gen_backlog_summary.py does 'from core import backlog' with no sys.path bootstrap, so when check_docs_fresh.py invokes it as a file it raises ModuleNotFoundError and writes nothing. check_docs_fresh.py:43 ignores the return code, so docs/BACKLOG-SUMMARY.md freshness is a no-op (summary stale since 2026-09-27). Fix: add the standard ROOT bootstrap and fail the gate on a non-zero generator exit (RCCA guard).

delivery.note: Fix + RCCA guard merged to develop
